units.source_text: 这时候，刚才那种奇异的脚步声从走廊上传了过来。

en.t: Just then, that strange sound of footsteps from before came down the corridor.

units.source_text: 我站起身子，走到廊道上。

en.t: I got up and went out into the corridor.

units.source_text: 只见柏木以承受着老师起居室的灯光的陆舟极高举起的濡湿了的黑乎乎的绿色树梢为背景，

en.t: There was Kashiwagi, with the wet, blackish-green treetops that Rikushu held high, catching the light from the teacher's sitting room, as his background,

units.source_text: 呆然立在那里一动不动，姿势活像是机械动作突然停止似的。

en.t: standing there in a daze without moving at all, his posture just like a machine whose motion had suddenly stopped.
A smile appeared on my face.

units.source_text: 柏木看到我，脸上才露出了近似恐怖的神情。

en.t: Only when Kashiwagi saw me did an expression close to terror appear on his face.
I was completely satisfied by that.
